heading: PDF Form Upload
page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Upload Form I-485 Upload G-28 PDF Evidence Review & Submit PDF Form Upload Upload all pages of the Form I-485 in PDF file format only. Place all pages in the correct order by referring to the page numbers on the form. For forms that have been scanned into PDF format, include all pages when uploading, even pages where you were not required to provide information (for example, Part 14. Additional Information is a page that may be left blank, but you should still upload Part 14. with your completed form). You must: Upload one PDF file of the form; Include all pages of the form in the file, even if you did not provide any information on the page; and Arrange the form in the same order as its page numbers. If you choose to physically sign our PDF form prior to scanning, please ensure that the signature you provided on the PDF complies with USCIS regulations and policies. Namely, the signature must be handwritten, may not be typed, created

buttons.text: Choose or drop file here to upload

_note: Page title 'USCIS | Upload PDF (I-485)'. Pure upload page, identical in shape to the I-765 /form page: one PDF of the complete filled I-485, all pages in order, PDF only. Copy differs only in the blank-page example (I-485 cites 'Part 14. Additional Information'; the I-765 cited 'Part 6.'). Generic upload control text 'Choose or drop file here to upload'. On-page text requires a HANDWRITTEN signature on the PDF - use the signed I-485, not an unsigned draft.
